commands: cd cli && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go test -c -o TASK_TEMP/receiver-darwin-arm64.test ./internal/assurance/receiver
cd cli && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go test -c -o TASK_TEMP/receiver-linux-arm64.test ./internal/assurance/receiver
cd cli && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go test -c -o TASK_TEMP/receiver-windows-amd64.test.exe ./internal/assurance/receiver

result.listener: the public API binds only tcp4 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port; injected wildcard listeners are rejected and closed
result.identity: each server generates distinct 256-bit obx_test_ project and obx_ready_ parent bearers; authorization comparison is exact and constant-time
result.readiness: only the exact raw GET /_openbox/readiness target and exact parent bearer can return 204, once; query and encoded aliases, wrong identity, and replay return no useful response
result.bounds: all non-readiness requests consume the declared 1..10000 project request budget; exact readiness attempts have a fixed cap of 8; body, header, read, write, idle, and shutdown bounds are explicit
result.lifecycle: context cancellation and repeated Close stop the listener through one bounded graceful shutdown
result.tests: focused count-25, race, affected-assurance, full CLI, vet, format, and Darwin/Linux/Windows compile-only checks passed
result.independentReview: approved final hashes with no remaining high or medium SE-04-01 blocker; reviewer made no writes

limits: This task ran real local loopback HTTP lifecycle tests only. It did not execute a project, SDK, sandbox, Docker command, image, provider/model request, production endpoint, or external control-plane action.
SDK auth/evaluate wire shapes, ordering, capture, redaction, persistence, fixtures, relay behavior, and project-test integration remain owned by later Phase 04 tasks.
The readiness bearer is exposed only to the parent-facing Go caller by contract; SE-04-09 must prove it is absent from the child environment.
The server is a component proof, not a supported project-run path. Both Phase 03 sandbox tuples remain rejected.
